method: Direct visual inspection of exact PNG and labeled contact sheets; adjacent cells compared in ordered animation and clockwise look sequence. No artwork edits.

checks.clipping: No visible clipping in populated cells. Running hands, shoes and ponytails remain inside cell boundaries; jumping raised hands and seated pet silhouette remain complete.
checks.attachments: No visible broken neck, arm, wrist, leg or ponytail attachment. Jewelry remains adjacent to the ears and hands connect to sleeves.
checks.identity: Consistent pink glasses, dark curly hair and side ponytail, floral tunic, blue trousers and red-white shoes throughout. Facial expressions and pose changes retain the same character.
checks.direction_order: Clockwise progression is readable from up through right, down, left and up. Neighboring silhouettes and gaze directions progress without a sign reversal.
checks.loop_337_5_to_000: Both are nearly frontal with elevated pupils; small residual left turn returns to centered up without a large pose jump.
checks.transition_000_to_022_5: Noticeable but coherent head turn: centered raised gaze becomes right-facing raised gaze. Body and foot placement stay stable; nose and ear arrangement change more than neighboring 022.5 to045.
checks.transition_157_5_to_180: Noticeable shift from right-biased lowered face to centered chin-tucked down face. Feet/body remain stable, and down pitch is maintained; crown and facial position shift more strongly than neighboring135 to157.5.
checks.animation_continuity: Run rows alternate extended stride and tucked-leg phases with consistent facing. Idle, wave, waiting, petting and review cells return toward their starting pose. Jump ends standing with arms raised, so return to its crouched start is a visible state change if replayed continuously.

warnings.evidence: Rightward nose/profile is clear, but chin remains nearly level and downward pupil displacement is weak. This reads closer to right with a subtle downward component than an unmistakable diagonal down-right.
Upward pupils and raised chin are clear. Screen-left component is very subtle in this nearly frontal face; it can read as centered up when viewed alone.
Angular motion is uneven: these front-to-three-quarter transitions are larger than several neighboring steps. No detached anatomy, clipping or identity break accompanies the change.
Last frame is standing with both arms raised; first frame crouches with hands close to face. This is a substantial reset if the five-frame jump is treated as a continuous loop.

limits: Static ordered-cell review cannot establish playback timing or temporal smoothness at the actual runtime frame rate.
